evidence.reason: The test does not actually distinguish use of the refreshed manifest from use of the stale manifest: the stale checksum is "2"*64 and the refreshed checksum is "3"*64, while the downloaded bytes hash to neither. An implementation that verifies against the stale checksum still raises ValueError and leaves no final image, so the test falsely passes. Writing vm.sha256_bytes(b"unexpected") to the stale manifest makes the stale path succeed while the refreshed path still raises, which is the smallest fix and does not change product behavior.
